blocks.text: Matcha lovers have another weekend market to look forward to! Salu Salo Market and Cabana Club are set to host Matcha Social Fest on November 28–29, 2026, at Bigger Pictures, Mandaluyong City. The two-day event will feature a mix of local businesses, with plenty of matcha, food, and other finds to explore. Visitors can expect a selection of matcha drinks and desserts, alongside food stalls and brands offering fashion, lifestyle, and other unique products. Whether you’re looking to try something new, find your next favorite local brand, or simply spend the weekend browsing through the market, there’s plenty to check out. […]...
